selection: Modern Russian, same upstream writer directory. Seven-page original16 source document and separate nine-page fpr16 held-out target document. Selected for available source+target volume, before new recognition.

conditions.A: plain, no references or reading skill
conditions.B: references extracted from all7raw sources, plain reader
conditions.C: references extracted from same7sources plus published full source transcription, plain reader

extraction_budget: At most24 retained original-pixel crops per packet; inspect all seven source scans before selecting; labelled contact sheet max1600x2400. Do not fill uncertain examples.
target_budget: Max3 image inspections per target page, reference inspections additional and recorded.
scoring: Primary whole-document CER after numeric page-order joining, against full target supplied text. No page-level gold mapping supplied. Reading NFC/casefold/Unicode punctuation removal/spacecollapse; literal NFC/spacecollapse secondary.
limits: Upstream source text may differ from copied handwriting, so not independent verified ground truth.
One writer and one run per condition, not general uplift estimate.
Source full-text has no page alignment; extractors must visually locate actual fragments.
Reader condition receives selected source crops and labels only, not full source or any target text.
